notes.title: New Project — Souls of the Dead
notes.content:
[p]Friends, I want to present to you a new game — "[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3925320"]Souls of the Dead[/url]". I have very serious plans for this project. The goal is to create not just a mindless zombie-killing romp, but a game that makes you think about values, actions, and their significance in the modern world, especially whether they have meaning without the society around us.[/p][p][/p][p]The main emphasis is on dynamics and the development of the narrative with well-developed locations, rather than puzzles in the style of "escape the room" – there are none in the game. Inspired by "The Walking Dead," a mechanic has been implemented where the only way to permanently kill an enemy is to damage its brain. And, of course, if a person dies, sooner or later they turn into a zombie. The game offers a diverse combat system: from kicks and melee weapons to firearms. The game will also delight you with the possibility of complete cooperative walkthrough.[/p][p][/p][p]Overall, I strongly believe in this project. I really hope and will try my best to realize everything conceived, although it takes a lot of time.[/p][hr][/hr][p][i]And, of course, huge thanks for the support of "Skufs VS Quadrobers".[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your attention![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3925320"][/dynamiclink]
[/p]

notes.title: Simplified Chinese Language and Motion Blur Setting
notes.content: [p][b]This update adds localization for Simplified Chinese, as well as a new option in the settings: enabling/disabling motion blur.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]I invite you to check out my new game, which I've been working on for 4 years — [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3925320"]Souls of the Dead[/url]. It features a mechanic that many people liked in "The Walking Dead": a zombie is alive as long as its brain is intact, and if an NPC-human (if the brain is not damaged) dies, it will eventually rise as a zombie.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Huge thanks to everyone who has already supported the project, and to all those who decide to do so. Thank you for this journey, and enjoy the game![/i][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3925320"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Improved Cutscene Performance
notes.content:
In this update, we focused on improving performance during cutscenes.

Graphics Optimization (Tip):
We've noticed that many players change all graphics settings when trying to improve performance. However, many settings have a small impact on performance while significantly degrading image quality.

We recommend primarily adjusting the "Render scale" setting. This parameter directly affects the rendering quality of 3D objects, and a small decrease in value will not noticeably reduce graphics quality while significantly increasing performance.

Multiplayer:
•  Fixed an issue with losing focus in the main menu.
•  Fixed a bug where locations were skipped when playing as a quadrober.

notes.title: Achievements and Co-op Improvements
notes.content:
This update introduces 10 new achievements. Additionally, we've addressed several multiplayer issues, including:
  •  Level restart errors
  •  Incorrect key input in the pause menu
  •  Level restart problems after death

notes.title: Cooperative Mode
notes.content:
This is a fully ready beta version of the cooperative mode, allowing you and your friends to play through the game together.

Key Changes:

Complete Playthrough: The cooperative beta allows you to play the entire game from start to finish.
Cooperative Mode Balance: Balance changes have been made for a better cooperative experience:
  •  Skuf: 8 health points (instead of 12 in single-player).
  •  Quadriber: 3 health points (instead of 6 in single-player).
Single-Player Playthrough:
  • Quadriber: 6 health points (formerly 4).

Recommendation: It is recommended that the user with the best performance host the game to minimize slowdowns and other issues, as they will be handling the server-side logic.
